newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dover raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dover raised to buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Phua Young said he upgraded his rating on Dover Corp to buy from outperform on an increased confidence in Dover's ability to hit earnings estimates.
-- "Semiconductor equipment has had problems but I think there are enough other good things going on so the company will make up for it," he said.
-- He has share earnings estimates of $2.90 for 1996 and $3.20 for 1997.
-- Young said he raised his 12-18 month target to $60 from the mid-50s.
